description: Who else may open the app's PRE (its private test version at play.neblla.com/pre/<slug or id>/). The developer always can. Two ways in: Neblla accounts by email (they sign in on the pre page), and links with a password for people without an account. Either can have an expiry. Once in, a person keeps a pass for 4 hours even if they sign out, so they can play as a guest; removing someone stops new passes, not one already given. Actions: "list"; "add" (email, expiresAt?) — let an account in, or change its expiry; "remove" (email); "link" (password?, expiresAt?, label?) — a new link; without a password one is generated. The password is returned ONCE: give it to the developer and never store it; "revoke" (linkId); "renewLocalKey" — a new local key, the old one stops working. Each action returns the current list. The list also has `local`: { key, tag }, the app's local key. A page on localhost (the developer's machine) opens only the app's PRE, and only with the tag that carries it: <script src=".../connect/app/_<appId>?pa=<key>">. Give the tag to the developer for their local index.html; never put the key in a page that is published.

email.description: For "add" and "remove": the Neblla account's email

expiresAt.description: For "add" and "link": ISO date after which it no longer opens pre (omit for no expiry)

label.description: For "link": a name for it, such as who it was sent to

password.description: For "link": 6 to 128 characters; omit to get a generated one

name: neblla_pre_access
